localizedValues.name: O261
localizedValues.description:
The oTENTik tent is a spacious blend of a tent and an A-frame cabin equipped with beds and furniture on a raised floor.
Each oTENTik includes: A table and seating area for 6 people, propane heater, solar-powered lamp, fire extinguisher, smoke and carbon monoxide detector, broom and dustpan.
Each oTENTik campsite includes: A deck, 2 deck chairs, a picnic table and a firepit. A service building containing showers and washrooms is located nearby.
What To Bring: Sleeping bags, blankets and pillows (extra blankets and sleeping bags are recommended in May and September), food, drinks, a water container (campground water is potable), cooking equipment, a cook stove, dishes, eating utensils, a cooler, flashlights, matches or a lighter, camping chairs and slippers or indoor shoes to help keep a clean oTENTik.
Pets are permitted in oTENTik o261.

localizedValues.name: O261
localizedValues.description:
La tente oTENTik est une construction spacieuse à mi-chemin entre la tente et un chalet en A, montée sur un plancher surélevé et munie de lits et de meubles.
